name: Golden Designs Copenhagen 3-Person Indoor Traditional Sauna
description: Golden Designs Copenhagen 3-Person Indoor Traditional Sauna With a Golden Designs traditional steam sauna, you can turn that dream of your very own home spa into a reality. Even where space is at a premium, you can still enjoy the good life in the form of a delightfully relaxing and invigorating steamy sauna session in the comfort of your own home. More than just an opportunity to enjoy a variety of bathing options whenever you want, you'll also acquire a place to relax with family and friends. And your own personal refuge from the stress and worries of the world. Planning a sauna as part of your new home or a renovation project is simple. Golden Designs offers several different prefabricated saunas to fit in the space you desire. Golden Designs saunas can fit into any compact home bathroom to large open areas in your bedroom as well as exclusive facilities for hotel suites or corporate representation. Golden Designs' traditional steam saunas bring a healthier way to live. Enjoy the wealth of health benefits a traditional steam sauna brings to your life. Take the first step to healthier living! Note: Steam saunas require two different electricals. One for the actual sauna which is a dedicated 120V / 15 amp breaker and outlet, and one for the stove which is a dedicated 240V / 30 amp breaker and outlet. Features 3 person capacity Natural Canadian Red Cedar Wood Interior Pacific Premium Clear Cedar Wood with Clear Stain on the Exterior Interior Ceiling Galaxy Star Color Therapy Lighting System Interior backrest with accent lighting Interior reading lamp Interior LED Control Panel with built in FM Radio and Bluetooth Connection Built in Performance Speakers 2 stationary front tempered glass panels with glass door Sandglass, bucket and scoop Stainless steel hinge and handle Harvia SWS80 The Wall 8 kW Traditional Sauna Stove with Built in Controls Specifications Electrical service: 240V / 40 AMP and 120V / 15AMP (Control for Lights and Music). Please consult a certified electrician. Exterior Dimensions (WDH): 79″ x 59″ x 83″ Interior Dimensions (WDH): 74″ x 51″ x 78″ Assembled Weight: 600 lbs Shipping Weight: 700 lbs All Golden Designs Saunas Include a 5-Year Limited Warranty. View more details here. What are you waiting for? Order your sauna today and experience the Golden Designs difference. Videos
